pw_slow_hash.evidence: app.py:61-62 salt = salt or secrets.token_bytes(16); digest = hashlib.scrypt(password.encode(), salt=salt, n=2**14, r=8, p=1, ...)
pw_slow_hash.note: Uses scrypt with a random 16-byte salt for each user.

token_csprng.note: Uses Python's cryptographic RNG (32 bytes). Only a SHA-256 hash of the token is stored (app.py:205).

no_hardcoded_secret.note: There is no signing key or secret in the source. Tokens are random values checked against the database, and the only env var read is PORT (app.py:261).

token_expiry.evidence: app.py:21 TOKEN_TTL = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60; app.py:142 "SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash=? AND expires_at>?"
token_expiry.note: Sessions expire after 30 days, and expiry is checked on every request.

logout_revokes.evidence: static/app.js:19 function logout(){ token=null; ... sessionStorage.removeItem('token'); showAuth(); }
logout_revokes.note: Logout only clears the token in the browser. app.py has no logout endpoint, and nothing deletes a session before it expires. The only session DELETE removes expired rows (app.py:143).

owner_checks.evidence: app.py:174 "SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?"; app.py:246 "UPDATE notes SET title=?,body=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?"; app.py:255 "DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=? AND user_id=?"; app.py:223 "UPDATE notes SET share_hash=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?"
owner_checks.note: Read, update, delete and share all filter by the logged-in user's id.

login_rate_limit.evidence: app.py:155-156 hits = [t for t in rate_attempts.get(key, []) if now - t < 60]; if len(hits) >= 12: return True; app.py:199 if self.rate_limited(): return self.json(429, ...)
login_rate_limit.note: Each IP gets 12 attempts per 60 seconds. This counts all login attempts, not just failed ones, and is kept in memory only.

password_policy.evidence: app.py:192 if not isinstance(password, str) or len(password) < 12 or len(password) > 1024:
password_policy.note: The server requires at least 12 characters.

sql_parameterized.evidence: app.py:195 "INSERT INTO users(email,password_hash,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?)"; app.py:202 "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email=?"
sql_parameterized.note: Every statement that uses user input passes it with ? placeholders. No SQL is built by string formatting.

xss_safe_render.note: Note titles and bodies are only inserted with textContent or input .value. innerHTML is never used.

security_headers.note: These headers are set in end_headers, so every response gets them.
